description: A new corporate presence at Global Dynamics unsettles Eureka as Carter faces increasingly dangerous experiments, shifting relationships and mysteries that stretch across the town's past and future.

s03e01.description: The DOD sends corporate fixer Eva Thorne to audit Global Dynamics just as an anti-missile test goes wrong and an intelligent drone named Martha begins threatening Eureka.

s03e02.description: Carter and Allison investigate a scientist’s impossible disappearance from a sealed biosphere while Thorne begins restructuring Global Dynamics around efficiency and profit.

s03e03.description: Exploding robotic dogs disrupt Eureka’s annual competition while Carter alone experiences strange earthquakes, Zoe questions her advanced studies and Allison prepares for her wedding.

s03e04.description: On Allison and Stark’s wedding day, Carter becomes trapped in a repeating time loop and must discover what is resetting the day before the cycle causes irreversible damage.

s03e05.description: The opening of an Egyptian tomb at Global Dynamics unleashes bizarre events and a missing mummy, leaving Carter to determine whether the supposed curse has a scientific explanation.

s03e06.description: A mysterious figure appears able to walk through walls while Zoe, her friends and Zane become trapped in an abandoned underground facility, forcing Carter to solve both crises before time runs out.

s03e07.description: Eureka’s mayoral campaign is interrupted when Zoe’s science partner accidentally creates a second sun over the town, turning local politics into another survival problem.

s03e08.description: As Thorne prepares to permanently seal an old underground military complex, Zoe begins aging at a terrifying rate and Carter races to connect her condition to Eureka’s buried history.

s03e09.description: Carter interviews for a Homeland Security job while Jo resigns rather than work for an automated replacement sheriff, leaving Eureka to discover whether law enforcement can really be mechanized.

s03e10.description: Jo’s exhausting physical exam and a new DNA-based security system collide when the technology malfunctions, putting her identity and the town’s automated defenses into dangerous confusion.

s03e11.description: When objects begin moving without explanation, Carter and newcomer Tess Fontana investigate a phenomenon that appears to connect Eureka with another dimension.

s03e12.description: A bitter rivalry with Area 51 erupts during a bowling tournament, and a prank creates a rapidly growing blob that forces Carter to stop both the creature and the scientists escalating the feud.

s03e13.description: Eureka residents begin stealing objects in their sleep and assembling them into strange towers, leading Carter to investigate the signal compelling the town’s teenagers to build.

s03e14.description: A decades-old spacecraft project suddenly returns carrying unexpected passengers, forcing Henry to confront unfinished work from his past after the mission brings death and danger back to Eureka.

s03e15.description: Scientists begin dying from impossible drownings on dry land, while Allison’s environmentally friendly baby shower becomes entangled with the same strange phenomenon.

s03e16.description: A town time-capsule project and Global Dynamics’ sonic cleaning combine disastrously when memory loss spreads through the facility, leaving two people trapped and Allison going into labor.

s03e17.description: Tess’s first day leading Global Dynamics is disrupted by Taggart’s return and a runaway Arctic ice core that sends temperatures across Eureka plunging toward catastrophic levels.

s03e18.description: A growing magnetic disturbance threatens Eureka while Tess considers leaving for a job in Australia and Carter struggles with Zoe preparing to leave town for college.
